description: Remote JioSaavn API endpoint configuration for Pulse Music Player AI. The app fetches this file at startup (cached in memory) so endpoints can be reordered, disabled, or replaced after release WITHOUT shipping an app update. Order matters: the app tries endpoints top to bottom, skipping any that are down (circuit breaker).

endpoints.note: saavn.sumit.co — VERIFIED LIVE with working 320kbps CDN streams (206 audio/mp4). Tried FIRST.
